I've been with this surgery since 2021 and I am very happy with my choice. There are some very good, caring doctors such as Dr Brunton and Dr Hayes who would listen to their patients and help them a lot.

For example, I came to the surgery with a shoulder pain and Dr Brunton gave me a thorough examination. She referred me for further investigations and, also, she discovered a small lump in my breast that I wasn't aware of. She referred me to the breast clinic and I received an excellent service.  I'm glad I was checked, thanks to Dr Brunton's proactive approach. Dr Hayes really listened to my chronic allergy and sinusitis issues and gave me a very helpful treatment and advice.

I'm also very grateful to the Reception Manager who went out of her way and re-registered my son with the surgery quickly.

Every time I contacted my surgery, whether in person or by phone, I would get help soon. Sometimes , they can be very busy, but one has to be a little bit more patient and appreciate how many patients they have to deal
